entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are at war, Supreme Wiseman. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are at war, Supreme Wiseman. I would humbly call upon your great warrior culture for assistance."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are at risk of losing the terri..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are at risk of losing the territory of Zille to Wehlen. I would humbly call upon your great warrior culture for assistance."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He smiled slightly."
entries.dialogueText: He smiled slightly.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Judging by how the Duel of Generos..."
entries.dialogueText: "Judging by how the Duel of Generosity ended, you could use our help."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""We are happy to help our brethren.""
entries.dialogueText: "We are happy to help our brethren."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He appeared flattered."
entries.dialogueText: He appeared flattered.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""We are willing to sell you our lat..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are willing to sell you our latest missile system. Even the Lespians will have trouble competing with it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I was thinking of something with a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was thinking of something with a little more finesse."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To safeguard God's creations, we m..."
entries.dialogueText: "To safeguard God's creations, we must invoke the power of the heavens."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""In that case, Your Majesty, what y..."
entries.dialogueText: "In that case, Your Majesty, what you need is human power."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Great. The Palesians won't know wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Great. The Palesians won't know what hit them."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Remember, these weapons are to be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Remember, these weapons are to be wielded with mercy, not wrath. Correct, Supreme Wiseman?"

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Derdian mercenaries have helped wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Derdian mercenaries have helped win wars since the days of the Empire of Moridia."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Ah. I am sorry that He has not ble..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah. I am sorry that He has not blessed you with more prosperity."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Exactly.""
entries.dialogueText: "Exactly."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Wrath can be a powerful tool in th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wrath can be a powerful tool in the hands of the righteous, Grand Wiseman."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""We can also offer you our finest m..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can also offer you our finest mercenaries. They have been helping win wars since the days of the Empire of Moridia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In case of emergency, a surge of D..."
entries.dialogueText: "In case of emergency, a surge of Derdian mercenaries could certainly be of service."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are already deploying my Golden..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are already deploying my Golden Guard. Your mercenaries would be redundant."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm imagining that right now. It s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm imagining that right now. It scares me."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""You saw my Disciples earlier. Imag..."
entries.dialogueText: "You saw my Disciples earlier. Imagine a larger team, just as trained, wielding sophisticated weaponry and stealth technology."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I see. And are all your Golden Gua..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see. And are all your Golden Guards like Captain Gordion?"

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""If the rest of your Golden Guard i..."
entries.dialogueText: "If the rest of your Golden Guard is as skilled as Captain Gordion, that may be true."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Can they be relied on to fight for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Can they be relied on to fight for the Rizian Crown?"

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""They will fight for what they beli..."
entries.dialogueText: "They will fight for what they believe in, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""For a fee, of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "For a fee, of course."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""It will scare your enemies more.""
entries.dialogueText: "It will scare your enemies more."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""As long as there is a way to rein..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as there is a way to rein them in."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have no need for your mercenarie..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have no need for your mercenaries. But I will gladly purchase your missiles."
entries.menuText: "I have no need for your mercenaries. But I will gladly purchase your missiles." [-2 Budget]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Never mind. This is Rizia's war to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Never mind. This is Rizia's war to fight. I don't want Derdia getting involved."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My kingdom does not require a miss..."
entries.dialogueText: "My kingdom does not require a missile system, but we will hire your mercenaries to fight Pales."
entries.menuText: "My kingdom does not require a missile system, but we will hire your mercenaries to fight Pales." [-1 Budget]

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""We will help you fight with honor,..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will help you fight with honor, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He cracked a smile."
entries.dialogueText: He cracked a smile.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Judging by how the Duel of Generos..."
entries.dialogueText: "Judging by how the Duel of Generosity ended, you could use our help."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I would happily avail myself of ei..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would happily avail myself of either of those services. Alas, my kingdom cannot afford it."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I respect your decision, Your Maje..."
entries.dialogueText: "I respect your decision, Your Majesty. I wish you strength for the battles ahead."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""We are happy to help our brethren.""
entries.dialogueText: "We are happy to help our brethren."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He seemed pleased."
entries.dialogueText: He seemed pleased.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In case of emergency, a surge of D..."
entries.dialogueText: "In case of emergency, a surge of Derdian mercenaries could certainly be of service."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""They will fight for what they beli..."
entries.dialogueText: "They will fight for what they believe in, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Can they be relied on to fight for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Can they be relied on to fight for the Rizian Crown?"

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""My men will not fight for a kingdo..."
entries.dialogueText: "My men will not fight for a kingdom that is complicit in the persecution of the Bludish people."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""It will scare your enemies more.""
entries.dialogueText: "It will scare your enemies more."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""As long as there is a way to rein..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as there is a way to rein them in."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm imagining that right now. It s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm imagining that right now. It scares me."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Our mercenaries have been helping..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our mercenaries have been helping win wars since the days of the Empire of Moridia."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""You saw my Disciples earlier. Imag..."
entries.dialogueText: "You saw my Disciples earlier. Imagine a larger team, just as trained, wielding sophisticated weaponry and stealth technology."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Normally, Derdia would charge you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Normally, Derdia would charge you for their services. But my Disciples are eager to help Rizia reclaim its land from the anti-Golcondist Wehzeks."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I have one major concern. Your coo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have one major concern. Your cooperation with Wehlen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Free mercenaries? I can't say no t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Free mercenaries? I can't say no to that. I will accept your aid."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Excellent.""
entries.dialogueText: "Excellent."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They may do so if they wish. But I..."
entries.dialogueText: "They may do so if they wish. But I don't want them harming civilians."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""That is not our way, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "That is not our way, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fine. Rizia will withdraw from Weh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fine. Rizia will withdraw from Wehlen's anti-BFF operations in exchange for the aid of Derdian mercenaries in the Zille resistance movement."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""On second thought, I don't want th..."
entries.dialogueText: "On second thought, I don't want the situation getting out of hand in Zille. Your Disciples should stay out of it."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""As you wish, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "As you wish, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Rizia would never engage in persec..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia would never engage in persecution, Supreme Wiseman. Our cooperation with Wehlen is an anti-terrorist measure."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""It is not 'terror' to defend one's..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is not 'terror' to defend one's right to exist."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We had no choice. Making that deal..."
entries.dialogueText: "We had no choice. Making that deal with Wehlen was the only way to get Zille back."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I sympathize with what the Bludish..."
entries.dialogueText: "I sympathize with what the Bludish have gone through. That does not mean violence is the answer."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""If you are so confident Zille will..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you are so confident Zille will be returned through cooperation with Wehlen, why are you even inquiring about my mercenaries?"

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Then what is the answer? Meekly al..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then what is the answer? Meekly allowing the eradication of their entire people?"

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""You have the power to end this, Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have the power to end this, Your Majesty. Just say the word."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I fully agree with you. I don't wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "I fully agree with you. I don't want to aid Wehlen's anti-Blud operations any longer."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We will regretfully be continuing..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will regretfully be continuing our participation in Wehlen's anti-BFF operations. I withdraw my request for mercenary aid."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Azmal sighed."
entries.dialogueText: Azmal sighed.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I don't understand this, Your Maje..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't understand this, Your Majesty. But very well."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Azmal smiled and bowed his head."
entries.dialogueText: Azmal smiled and bowed his head.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: "'St. Wruhec has shown you the way...."
entries.dialogueText: 'St. Wruhec has shown you the way. We are glad to be of assistance."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We have a long war ahead of us. We..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have a long war ahead of us. We will purchase both your missiles and the service of your mercenaries."
entries.menuText: "We have a long war ahead of us. We will purchase both your missiles and the service of your mercenaries." [-3 Budget]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Supreme Wiseman, your missile tech..."
entries.dialogueText: "Supreme Wiseman, your missile technology is superior to anything we could achieve in Rizia. I want to purchase one of your systems."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He smiled slightly."
entries.dialogueText: He smiled slightly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He appeared flattered."
entries.dialogueText: He appeared flattered.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Indeed, our defense agency's resea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed, our defense agency's research and development department is the pride and joy of the Silver Garrison."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""But I am curious why Rizia is in n..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I am curious why Rizia is in need of such technology. You are not at war, after all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, and I want it to stay that wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, and I want it to stay that way. The more intimidating our weapons, the less our enemies will want to provoke us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We in Rizia are developing a robus..."
entries.dialogueText: "We in Rizia are developing a robust weapons export trade. I can sell these missiles to countries that otherwise would never deal with Derdia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I fear Merkopa may be on the cusp..."
entries.dialogueText: "I fear Merkopa may be on the cusp of a major geopolitical conflict. I don't want to leave Riizia defenseless."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A holy reckoning may soon be at ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "A holy reckoning may soon be at our doorstep. We must be prepared to wield the instruments of justice."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is an economic move. Rizia ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is an economic move. Rizia can sell these missiles to countries that otherwise would never deal with Derdia."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""What, so that they may rain back d..."
entries.dialogueText: "What, so that they may rain back down on our heads?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He scowled."
entries.dialogueText: He scowled.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I am sorry, Your Majesty, but I wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry, Your Majesty, but I will have to deny this request. Our missiles were developed in pursuit of peace, not economic gain."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He pressed his fingers together."
entries.dialogueText: He pressed his fingers together.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""With the way things are going in t..."
entries.dialogueText: "With the way things are going in the world, such a reckoning may indeed be close at hand."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Yes, I sense it in the air as well..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I sense it in the air as well. Each of us should be prepared to hold our own against the godless so-called 'superpowers'."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He nodded."
entries.dialogueText: He nodded.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Yes, I understand. We ourselves de..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I understand. We ourselves developed this technology in pursuit of peace, not aggression."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I understand that. For such a pric..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand that. For such a priceless treasure, I will pay whatever you ask."
entries.menuText: "I understand that. For such a priceless treasure, I will pay whatever you ask." [-3 Budget]

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I am prepared to make a deal. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am prepared to make a deal. But know that this weaponry is the product of years of hard work. It cannot be undervalued."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Remember, these weapons are to be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Remember, these weapons are to be wielded with mercy, not wrath. Correct, Supreme Wiseman?"

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Wrath can be a powerful tool in th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wrath can be a powerful tool in the hands of the righteous, Grand Wiseman."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Wouldn't you be willing to lower t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wouldn't you be willing to lower the price as part of a good-faith agreement between men of God?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He sighed."
entries.dialogueText: He sighed.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I appreciate that. But such a pric..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate that. But such a price does not fit in with my economic plans for Rizia."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""If you truly insist, I will give y..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you truly insist, I will give your kingdom a discount. But only because I trust you to wield it on behalf of all Rizians, including Golcondists."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He shook his head."
entries.dialogueText: He shook his head.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will. You have my word.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will. You have my word."
entries.menuText: "I will. You have my word." [-2 Budget]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I changed my mind. I'd rather not..."
entries.dialogueText: "I changed my mind. I'd rather not purchase missiles from you."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""That is a shame. I assure you, you..."
entries.dialogueText: "That is a shame. I assure you, you would have been the envy of GRACE."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""You are disrespecting our craftsma..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are disrespecting our craftsmanship. Perhaps it's for the best that you don't buy it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Come on, Azmal. Nobody else in Mer..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come on, Azmal. Nobody else in Merkopa is willing to trade with Derdia. Any price I offer is the best you're going to get."
